verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online government service that holds applicant data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no user-facing retention settings or data-deletion capability. Withdrawing an IP application (docs-30) and updating representative details (docs-29) are adjacent procedural features, not data retention or deletion controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
